title: Jharkhandey Singh v. State of U.P. and 4 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Petition disposed after the theft-dues recovery was withdrawn.
headnote: A writ against a recovery citation for electricity-theft dues was disposed of after the electricity department stated that the recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed. The Court gave liberty to pass that order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, and did not decide the theft allegation or the citation on merits.
facts: Jharkhandey Singh petitioned the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and four others, challenging a recovery citation dated 18 August 2022 issued by respondent nos. 4 and 5 for electricity dues said to arise from theft. On 28 February 2023 counsel for the electricity department sought time for instructions, and the matter was put up as fresh on 15 March 2023. On that date the department stated that the recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed.

holding_units.topic: fresh order after withdrawal of theft-dues recovery
holding_units.holding: On the electricity department's statement that the recovery citation dated 18.08.2022 had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed, the writ was disposed of with liberty to the department to pass that order strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: The order names the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 but cites no numbered clause; 'procedure' records that wording and is not a Code clause id.

principle_tags.application: The petition ended on the department's withdrawal of the recovery citation and its undertaking to pass a fresh order. The Court did not construe any clause of the Supply Code; it only required the fresh order to follow the procedure the Code prescribes.

not_decided.point: Whether electricity was stolen and what dues, if any, remain recoverable.
not_decided.note: The impugned recovery was withdrawn. The Court left any fresh order to the department under the Supply Code procedure and did not examine the theft allegation or the citation dated 18.08.2022 on merits.
